name: Degrees and certificates awarded (all levels)
plain: How many degrees and certificates the colleges in an area awarded in an academic year, at every level.
definition: Every award colleges in the municipio gave in the academic year, first majors only: certificates and associate, bachelor's, master's and doctor's degrees. Counted at the campus that reports to IPEDS, not where the graduates live; a municipio with no college has 0. A college may report all its campuses from one place: NUC University reports its campuses and online programmes from Bayamón. The year is the end of the academic year (2024 = 2023-24).

coverage.frequency: Every academic year; NCES publishes a year about a year after it ends.

method: degrees.py reads NCES's IPEDS completions file and directory for each academic year, keeps Puerto Rico's institutions and first majors only, and adds each institution's awards to the municipio of its campus in that year's directory. Award levels: associate 3, bachelor's 5, master's 7, doctor's 17, 18 and 19. Fields are the first two digits of the CIP code. Two checks run every year: the six-digit rows add up to the file's own total (CIP 99) for every level, and the fields add up to the bachelor's and graduate degrees.
source_detail: NCES IPEDS completions (first majors) and directory, academic years ending 2015 to 2024, read from NCES's complete data files; counted by the municipio of each campus
caveats: Counted at the campus that reports to IPEDS, not where graduates live: most municipios have no college and read 0. A college may report all its campuses from one place: NUC University reports its campuses and online programmes from Bayamón (14,321 awards, 29.4% of the island's in 2023-24, mostly certificates), so Bayamón's count is far above where its students study.
Institutions report their own counts to NCES; a year is the academic year that ends in it (2024 = 2023-24).
First majors only: a student with two majors counts once.
